summary: First release: every NPC line, narration and answer option rewritten shorter, base game and all three story DLCs.

Restored lines the length limit had cut too far: Calcazar's and Argenta's prayers and Ulfar's poems in full, Calligos's suspicion of the xenos, and two Afterlight plot points. (Briefly numbered 1.0.1.)
Polished lines the shortening had cut into stilted or broken English, while keeping them short.
